ACME_CORP.ACME_GL_TRANSACTIONS.table_comment: ACME Corp General Ledger transactions. Contains financial postings including expenses and revenue. Join to ACME_DEPARTMENTS on DEPARTMENT_CODE and ACME_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS on ACCOUNT_CODE.

columns.PERIOD_NAME: Accounting period in MON-YYYY format, for example JAN-2025 or AUG-2025. Q1=JAN/FEB/MAR, Q2=APR/MAY/JUN, Q3=JUL/AUG/SEP, Q4=OCT/NOV/DEC. Query the data to determine available periods; do not assume a fixed range.
columns.ACCOUNT_TYPE: Transaction category. Common values include EXPENSE, REVENUE, ASSET, LIABILITY, and EQUITY. Use EXPENSE for cost or spending questions.
columns.DEPARTMENT_CODE: Department code for the transaction. Join to ACME_DEPARTMENTS.DEPARTMENT_CODE to get the department name.
columns.ACCOUNT_CODE: Account code for the transaction. Join to ACME_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_CODE to get account name and account type.
columns.DEBIT_AMOUNT: For EXPENSE rows sum DEBIT_AMOUNT to calculate total expenses or spending.
columns.CREDIT_AMOUNT: Credit-side amount. Do not use this for expense totals unless the question explicitly asks about credits.

ACME_CORP.ACME_DEPARTMENTS.table_comment: Department reference table for ACME Corp. Use to translate department codes into department names and organizational context.

columns.DEPARTMENT_CODE: Primary department code. Join to ACME_GL_TRANSACTIONS.DEPARTMENT_CODE.
columns.DEPARTMENT_NAME: Human-readable department name such as Finance, Engineering, Sales, Operations, Corporate, or Europe HQ.

ACME_CORP.ACME_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS.table_comment: Chart of accounts reference table. Use to map account codes to account names and financial categories.

columns.ACCOUNT_CODE: Primary account code. Join to ACME_GL_TRANSACTIONS.ACCOUNT_CODE.
columns.ACCOUNT_TYPE: Financial category such as EXPENSE or REVENUE.

ACME_CORP.ACME_PERIOD_CLOSE.table_comment: Month-end close task tracking table. Use for close status, assignments, and completion questions.

columns.STATUS: Close task status. Valid values include OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, and COMPLETE.
